assembly_summary: The original twelve-stroke drawing follows the observed head lowering, low hold and return. The native face-mask, eye marks and mouth U move down-left and foreshorten together inside the head during the source pitch, then return; the far ear stays attached at the observed side plane; native body/chest remains below, and the unobserved tail stays beyond the close-up crop. The plain wall is drawn once.
review_note: Fresh blind v3: The central down-left bow is not embodied in the low head poses: the doodle's face stays upright and high while the whole head moves left. This loses the source event even though the original doodle identity survives. Recognition and normal-speed playback remain unrun; zero planted-contact intervals cannot pass the four-interval gate. No training ran.
